program_name: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports

scorecard_recovery_rows.basis: duplicate payments, incorrect amounts, unapplied credits, and similar overpayments identified for collection
recovery-audit review of pre-authorized care claims, referrals, reimbursement methodology, and medical-record support
statistical-sample review and post-payment deep dives for systemic program deficiencies

agency_recovery_context.scope: VA-wide agency recovery reporting; not PLTSS program reporting

allowed_interpretation: Report projected overpayments and operational recovery rows separately with their own periods and bases.
prohibited_interpretations: do not divide recovered amounts by the projected FY2024 estimate
do not sum mixed-period recovery rows
do not treat VA-wide recovery as PLTSS recovery
do not label projected overpayments as collectible debt, fraud, prevented loss, or net savings
next_evidence_needed: PLTSS claim- or debt-cohort identifier linking sampled projected errors to established receivables
collection transactions tied to the same cohort and measurement period
disposition fields for appeal, reversal, write-off, offset, and non-collectability
control and recovery-administration cost plus veteran access and provider-burden effects
